The Overview and Scrutiny Committee reviews the most important strategic decisions and the direction of Tees Valley Combined Authority, and ensuring that any decisions made were in line with the Combined Authority’s agreed policies. The Committee meets quarterly. An agenda will be published five clear working days before the meeting.

Overview and Scrutiny Committee meetings are open to the public. Polices and guidance relating to public participation at Cabinet, Board, and Committee meetings can be found here.

The most recently approved version of the Committees’ Terms of Reference is available here.
